What this means
In this part you learn to recognize that God knows them by with a name on it their names as part of His creation  Learners to draw the palm of their hand and. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: recognize that God knows them by with a name on it their names as part of His creation  Learners to draw the palm of their hand and.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can recognize that God knows them by with a name on it their names as part of His creation  Learners to draw the palm of their hand and. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: recognize that God knows them by with a name on it their names as part of His creation  Learners to draw the palm of their hand and.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 1 learner study Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is your name?

1. Know what Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: recognize that God knows them by with a name on it their names as part of His creation  Learners to draw the palm of their hand and.
